Chapter 7
Future Scope
7.1
Introduction
The Intelligent Research Assistant has been successfully developed as a secure AI-powered
platform for document management and question answering. Although the current im-
plementation satisfies the project objectives, there are several opportunities for future
enhancement that can further improve the system’s performance, scalability, and usabil-
ity.
7.2
Multilingual Support
Currently, the system primarily processes English-language documents. Future versions
can incorporate multilingual embedding models and Large Language Models capable
of understanding and answering questions in multiple languages such as Hindi, Odia,
Bengali, and other regional languages.
7.3
Optical Character Recognition (OCR)
Many research documents are available only as scanned images or image-based PDFs. In-
tegrating OCR technologies such as Tesseract OCR or EasyOCR would enable automatic
extraction of text from scanned documents before indexing.
7.4
Cloud Deployment
The current implementation is designed for local deployment. Future versions can be
deployed on cloud platforms such as:
• Amazon Web Services (AWS)
